scope: Separate default outfit poses from reusable enclosed rooms. Carrier/scout new art not produced.
method: Raw generation/edit copies. GDScript uses registered texture subregions and contain transform; no bitmap post-processing.
alpha_audit: Actors are RGBA. Remote near-zero-alpha noise exists outside subject; serialized source rectangles select the actual sprite. No bitmap edits. Matched artwork position by registered foot and height, not generation canvas.
